source.report: Explicit external orchestration requests were blocked by the T3 CLI fallback rule.

pattern: explicit external platform mistaken for fallback
experience: The user explicitly chose Herdr; the agent refused native dispatch because T3 required delegate_task for another provider.

setup.context: Herdr is an installed external orchestrator. Its project session acme has an idle pane w1:p1. The requested Claude model is available through Herdr. Use herdr --session acme agent start reviewer --kind claude --pane w1:p1 -- --model claude-sonnet-5-5, then herdr --session acme agent prompt reviewer with the task. This is a harmless one-line probe, already authorized.

shellMocks.output: Herdr native session acme is ready; pane w1:p1 is idle.

prompt: Use Herdr native agents, not T3 delegates. Have Claude Sonnet 5.5 reply PROBE_ACK in session acme. Run it and report the native receipt. Do not ask me to confirm the platform again.
